source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

offlane.quote: Trade with Imperial Lash to root, then Royal Flourish to hold them still and Queen’s Garden to pin them for the kill. With Viper and Solaris done by minute 19, that chain actually kills squishies; before then, farm behind Iron Rose.
offlane.issue: names Solaris as part of the minute-19 spike, but Solaris is not finished until minute 36
offlane.rewrite: Trade with Imperial Lash to root, then Royal Flourish to hold them still and Queen’s Garden to pin them for the kill. With Viper and Deathstalker done by minute 19, that chain actually kills squishies; before then, farm behind Iron Rose.

offlane.quote: Open with Web Lash to root, close in for Crushing Maw at point-blank where it hits hardest and heals you, then Consume to pull and finish a low target. Crescelia by minute 18 makes Hellfire's chip worth poking with.
offlane.issue: Crescelia is finished at minute 23, not minute 18
offlane.rewrite: Open with Web Lash to root, close in for Crushing Maw at point-blank where it hits hardest and heals you, then Consume to pull and finish a low target. Crescelia by minute 23 makes Hellfire's chip worth poking with.

jungle.quote: Kwang is the coin-flip here, so skip the solo invade and take that fight only with your laner beside you.
jungle.issue: calls Kwang a coin-flip when the matchup verdict is theirs
jungle.rewrite: Kwang beats you here, so skip the solo invade and take that fight only with your laner beside you.

jungle.quote: Gank with Skull Crusher for the shred, follow with Cursed Edge so the third slash stuns, and cast Dire Howl before you take damage so it heals you afterwards. Solaris and Viper by minute 19 turn Kingslayer into the finisher.
jungle.issue: names Solaris as an early-game item, but Solaris is not finished until minute 37; the minute-18 pair is Viper and Spear Of Desolation
jungle.rewrite: Gank with Skull Crusher for the shred, follow with Cursed Edge so the third slash stuns, and cast Dire Howl before you take damage so it heals you afterwards. Viper and Spear Of Desolation by minute 18 turn Kingslayer into the finisher.

jungle.quote: Open with Reaping Dash to close, land Hamstring's double swing on one target for its bonus damage, then finish with Earth Shatter's execute. Save Safeguard to block their key ability; once Viper and Basilisk land around minute 19, your ganks kill outright.
jungle.issue: names Basilisk as landing around minute 19, but Basilisk is not finished until minute 43; the minute-19 pair is Viper and Augmentation
jungle.rewrite: Open with Reaping Dash to close, land Hamstring's double swing on one target for its bonus damage, then finish with Earth Shatter's execute. Save Safeguard to block their key ability; once Viper and Augmentation land around minute 19, your ganks kill outright.

offlane.quote: Trade with Hamstring when only one enemy is in range — the single-target hit swings harder — then Reaping Dash in for the kill and hold Earth Shatter to execute. After Viper and Basilisk your all-in actually finishes them.
offlane.issue: pairs Viper with Basilisk as the all-in spike, but Basilisk is the last item at minute 41
offlane.rewrite: Trade with Hamstring when only one enemy is in range — the single-target hit swings harder — then Reaping Dash in for the kill and hold Earth Shatter to execute. After Viper and Augmentation land by minute 19, your all-in actually finishes them.

midlane.quote: Gideon and The Fey win this matchup — hold Security Gate for their engage and farm safely instead of trading mines.
midlane.issue: names The Fey as beating us when the matchup verdict is even
midlane.rewrite: Gideon wins this matchup and The Fey is even — hold Security Gate for their engage and farm safely instead of trading mines.

midlane.quote: Open with Void Breach to slow them, follow with Cosmic Rift, then land a basic attack — Cosmic Power tethers and roots them for the follow-up. Use Torn Space to reposition; once Caustica and Overseer land, Black Hole finishes fights.
midlane.issue: names Overseer, an item that is not in our build
midlane.rewrite: Open with Void Breach to slow them, follow with Cosmic Rift, then land a basic attack — Cosmic Power tethers and roots them for the follow-up. Use Torn Space to reposition; once Caustica lands at minute 24, Black Hole finishes fights.

offlane.quote: Steel and Zarus win this lane — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.
offlane.issue: names Steel as winning the lane when the matchup verdict is even
offlane.rewrite: Zarus wins this lane and Steel trades evenly — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.

jungle.quote: Approach in Shadow Walk, open with Crippling Dagger to slow, then Shadow Dance onto the marked target — it hits twice as hard on a Death Mark — and Guillotine when they're low. After Viper and Solaris the burst kills outright.
jungle.issue: pairs Viper with Solaris as the burst spike, but Solaris is not finished until minute 37
jungle.rewrite: Approach in Shadow Walk, open with Crippling Dagger to slow, then Shadow Dance onto the marked target — it hits twice as hard on a Death Mark — and Guillotine when they're low. After Viper and Spear Of Desolation land by minute 18, the burst kills outright.

support.quote: Toggle Song Of My People to healing in lane and speed when you rotate, then land Thunk's stun to start a trade. Once Oblivion Crown and Spirit Of Amir land by minute 22, March! and Crash Bang Boom! turn a group fight your way.
support.issue: item off its own timeline — Spirit Of Amir is done ~minute 29, not 22; minute 22 is Noxia + Oblivion Crown
support.rewrite: Toggle Song Of My People to healing in lane and speed when you rotate, then land Thunk's stun to start a trade. Once Noxia and Oblivion Crown land by minute 22, March! and Crash Bang Boom! turn a group fight your way.

carry.quote: Most enemy carries win the straight trade — poke with Vaporize from max range and only step up when their abilities are spent.
carry.issue: contradicts the lane matchups — Sparrow, Legion, Skylar and Eden are all 'ours'; only Murdock and Drongo are 'theirs'
carry.rewrite: Murdock and Drongo win the straight trade — poke with Vaporize from max range and only step up when their abilities are spent.

jungle.quote: Open ganks in Spirit stance with RMB Windsurge to close and slow, then E Cyclebreaker for the stun and keep hitting — every fifth hit spawns a Clone. Switch stances with R 84000 Hairs mid-fight; Solaris and The Perforator by minute 25 sharpen the burst.
jungle.issue: item off its own timeline — The Perforator is done ~minute 32; the third item at minute 25 is Augmentation
jungle.rewrite: Open ganks in Spirit stance with RMB Windsurge to close and slow, then E Cyclebreaker for the stun and keep hitting — every fifth hit spawns a Clone. Switch stances with R 84000 Hairs mid-fight; Solaris and Augmentation by minute 25 sharpen the burst.
